None of these women are veiled. Next to them stands a smiling African servant woman. They are watching a very dark-skinned, tall, grinning African eunuch display an embarrassed, seminude East African slave woman clutching what remains of her garment. Another African slave holds a water pipe. A gazelle sits on the divan. Another wanders across the room.
